jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Upstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced upstream scientist who enjoys solving complex process challenges and turning scientific data into clear recommendations? Do you enjoy leading late-stage development studies and using your expertise to help clients move their processes towards clinical and commercial manufacturing?

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our Late-Stage Process Development team.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of six scientists and eight technicians working across upstream, downstream, and analytical disciplines. Together, we develop and characterize robust mammalian cell culture processes supporting clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Scientist, you will lead upstream late-stage development activities, with a particular focus on process characterization, down-scale model qualification, and scientific data analysis.

You will be responsible for your assigned scientific activities, from study design and data interpretation to technical recommendations and reporting. As a subject matter expert (SME), you will also serve as a key scientific contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping explain process performance, address technical challenges, and recommend practical next steps.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Planning and leading process characterization (PC) studies, including experimental design, data evaluation, and preparation of PC work reports.

• Designing and evaluating down-scale model qualification (DSMQ) studies to demonstrate representativeness of manufacturing-scale processes.

• Applying statistical methods, including Design of Experiments (DoE), and tools such as JMP to support data-driven scientific conclusions.

• Contributing to FMECA and other process risk assessments to identify critical process parameters and support control strategy development.

• Supporting late-stage development activities, including Limit of In Vitro Cell Age (LIVCA) studies, Working Cell Bank (WCB) activities, scale-up, and technology transfer.

• Providing scientific guidance to laboratory technicians, collaborating across functions, and communicating technical findings, project status, and recommendations to clients.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in biotechnology, biochemical engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

• Communicate effectively with clients and cross-functional colleagues and are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with JMP, DoE, AMBR250, DSMQ, FMECA, statistical equivalence testing, process modelling, or regulatory submissions will be an advantage. We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect you to have experience with every method or technology listed.

You work independently, take responsibility for your commitments, and maintain high standards of scientific quality. You can structure your work and prioritize competing tasks, even when project requirements change.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to lead late-stage upstream development studies and work on different scientific and process challenges.

• A multidisciplinary environment where scientific discussions, collaboration, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

• A manager who gives you room to plan your work independently, values honest discussions, and is available when you need support.

• An initial mentoring arrangement to help you become familiar with our processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you are motivated by combining scientific expertise, project responsibility, and client collaboration, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Expected Start Date: February 1, 2027

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to drive complex projects in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization. You will translate project strategies into integrated plans and coordinate delivery across internal teams and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Working within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain to advance late-stage programs towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of project delivery, influence cross-functional decisions and strengthen project management practices through mentoring and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities

**CMC project planning and delivery

• Develop and execute integrated project plans, timelines and milestones aligned with the Drug Development Plan. Provide input to optimize project strategy and translate agreed priorities into clear deliverables

• Coordinate internal and external activities, including technology transfer, process validation and manufacturing readiness, managing cross-functional dependencies and ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery

• Lead proactive risk management, prioritizing risks and driving mitigation, escalation and resolution. Maintain current plans, dashboards, action and decision logs, and communicate progress and emerging issues

Supplier coordination and regulatory readiness

• Create and oversee statements of work with relevant functions. Manage project budgets and forecasts, track invoices and proactively address variances against agreed scope, costs and timelines

• Coordinate CDMO and other external partner activities, follow up on deliverables and gather stakeholder input on vendor performance. Build effective relationships and resolve issues collaboratively

• Conduct line-of-business reviews of regulatory documentation supporting global submissions. Ensure technical compliance and timely delivery of source documentation in collaboration with subject matter experts and Regulatory Affairs

• Ensure adherence to Genmab’s quality system requirements. Understand the technical implications of supplier quality agreements, flag risks and coordinate follow-up with Quality and relevant functions

Project governance and ways of working

• Represent project management in internal and external forums. Communicate priorities, risks and recommendations, align stakeholders on decisions and ensure agreed actions are documented and followed through

• Use lessons learned to recommend and implement improvements to project management processes, systems and tools, strengthening consistency and operational effectiveness across the organization

• Train, mentor and guide colleagues in project management practices. Share experience and support effective project execution through informal leadership and constructive feedback

**Requirements

**

• 
Master’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage

• 
At least six years of experience in Tech Ops or a related field within a relevant industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• 
Demonstrated success managing complex projects in a cross-functional environment, preferably within late-stage biologics development, with strong planning, budget and risk management skills

• 
Proven ability to influence and coordinate multicultural teams and internal and external stakeholders without direct authority

• 
Solid experience managing CDMOs and contract research organizations, with a strong understanding of intellectual property implications

• 
Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, GMP and regulatory documentation requirements, and their application to CMC project delivery.

• 
Experience implementing process or system improvements, with strong proficiency in project management systems, dashboards and reporting tools.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics and recommendations clearly

The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK644.640,00---966.960,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Build the Data Foundation for Greener Rail
jobs.description:
Cubris · A Hitachi Rail company · Ballerup, Denmark · On-site with flexibility

Would you like to use your expertise in Python, geospatial data and data platforms to make rail operations smarter and more energy-efficient? At Cubris, you will play a central role in developing the data foundation behind solutions that help train operators reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who enjoys shaping technical direction, building solutions and working closely with colleagues across engineering, architecture and product.

Your role

You will help shape the data platform and geospatial model supporting our GreenSpeed® platform and Infrastructure Management System. You will turn complex railway data into a consistent, reliable foundation for our software – covering everything from tracks, signals and stations to gradients, speed limits and temporary restrictions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop our data platform and geospatial model: Define schemas, feature classes, linear referencing using track and chainage, topology rules and railway asset attributes.

• 
Build robust Python data pipelines: Ingest, transform and integrate data, and automate workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

• 
Develop spatial storage and cloud solutions: Work with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or equivalent technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, and apply graph-based structures where they add value.

• 
Ensure data quality and traceability: Validate geometries, topology and attributes, and document data models and workflows with appropriate versioning and change control.

• 
Translate requirements into practical solutions: Collaborate with architects, software engineers, product managers and DevOps to deliver solutions that meet today’s needs and evolve with our products.

What you bring

You have substantial hands-on experience in data platform development and architecture, and you enjoy both making technical decisions and implementing them.

We are particularly interested in your:

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with scalable data pipelines, data integration and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR, PyProj or equivalent geospatial technologies, including LineString and MultiLineString geometries.

• 
Knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial databases.

• 
Experience developing cloud-native data solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

• 
Ability to work independently when requirements are evolving and documentation is still taking shape.

We also welcome a strong engineering grounding in industrial systems. You may have developed this through your education or through experience in transport, manufacturing, energy or automation. You understand how software, data and physical infrastructure interact, and how to translate real-world assets and operating conditions into accurate data models. You also appreciate the demands for quality, reliability and traceability in systems used in daily operations.

Experience with QGIS or ArcGIS, graph-based data structures and algorithms, safety-critical systems, railway technology or EBuLa integration would be an advantage.

As a colleague, you share your knowledge, contribute ideas and enjoy solving problems with others. You can balance long-term technical quality with practical delivery.

Why join Cubris?

You will have a real say in technical decisions and product development in a company where ideas can quickly become action. Our flat, agile organisation encourages open dialogue and gives you room to take ownership.

You will join a small, autonomous team backed by Hitachi Rail’s international expertise and resources. Your work will serve a clear purpose: smarter rail operations with lower energy consumption and CO₂ emissions.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark. We value close collaboration in the office while offering flexibility.

About Cubris

Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

****Maternity leave cover: January - June 2027

**As Senior Product Development Manager, you'll be the senior product voice in the Menu & Innovation team, owning our highest priority global NPD projects and the systems, standards and ways of working that sit behind every product we launch. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners, Supply Chain and our supplier partners to make sure JOE products are consistently great in every market. This is a lead role in the menu & product team: you'll set the direction for how we develop, test and approve products worldwide, coach the wider team, and help shape how the team grows and operates globally. You'll have real scope to define the future of our global menu, always keeping juicer ease at the heart.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Drive end-to-end ownership of high priority global NPD projects, including new categories, new occasions and growth platforms, from brief through to in-store launch.

• Lead on all global NPD systems and processes, defining and continuously optimising them as JOE scales.

• Define and own the JOE global product testing framework and approach for all products, from scale-up kitchen trials to product operational testing to global scale commercial consumer testing.

• Lead on future NPD team growth strategies and the expansion of our global operating model.

• Own all core EPD quality workstreams across defined products and categories.

• Own all product and ingredient standards, making sure the JOE quality bar is upheld globally.

• Lead high functioning cross-functional project teams; with all global teams and local markets, from Operations and Marketing to Franchise and Supply Chain.

• Champion best-in-class trend diagnosis, coaching the wider team on how to diagnosis, read & interpret trends, in a Joe way, and run sharp competitor reviews to keep a finger on the pulse.

• Partner with all key suppliers, owning strong relationship management and engagement across current and new suppliers for current and future projects.

• Maintain and nurture a tightly connected global product network across equity and franchise; now and as it scales, so opportunities are identified, shared and recognised and everyone stays aligned.

• Key point of contact for our franchise team (current and new) on all product activity beyond equity stores; ensuring global brand consistency whilst driving local relevancy

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Excellent project management skills and experience

• Senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions, markets and franchise partners.

• Experience coaching and developing others

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 8 years' experience in corporate product development, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant), with a track record of owning global or multi-market launches.

• Proven experience building or improving NPD systems, processes and testing frameworks, including scale-up, operational and consumer testing.

• Deep familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance.

• Strong supplier management skills, with experience owning relationships across a global supply base.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

At DESMI Ro-Clean, we develop and deliver equipment and solutions for oil spill response, as well as the collection of seaweed and marine debris. Our customers are located worldwide, and our deliveries range from individual products to large-scale, technical system solutions.

**What We’re About

• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

**If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

Use the Apply button to submit your application. We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jacob Rathgen - DESMI at jara@desmi.com.

**_Are you interested in Linux, Windows, Oracle, Azure, or VMware, or perhaps all of them? Would you like to work with infrastructure and operations for complex IT solutions that make a real difference for both public sector organizations and private businesses? If so, you could be Netcompany’s next Operations Engineer.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Netcompany Operations consists of specialized and cross-functional teams working across a wide range of technologies, including Linux, Oracle, Windows, Cloud, and Infrastructure, covering networking, servers, backup, and storage.

Based on your technical interests and expertise, you will join one of our operations teams, where you will take ownership of your own responsibilities while working closely with colleagues to deliver large-scale operational projects for our customers. You will have the opportunity to learn from some of the most experienced specialists in your field, while also contributing your own knowledge and perspectives to the team.

**

**At Netcompany Operations, technical expertise and a passion for IT operations are at the core of what we do. As our new colleague, we hope you share that same enthusiasm.

**

**Continue developing with us

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Are you motivated by creating measurable improvements through data, technology, and customer insights? Do you want to influence how millions of customers experience JYSK across multiple markets?

At JYSK, we are expanding our team to strengthen our digital foundation and unlock new opportunities within marketing technology. We are looking for an Email Marketing Automation & Conversion Specialist who can help optimise customer journeys, improve conversion rates, and ensure our email communication performs at its best.

Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will join an informal, social, and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key to success. In this specialist role, you will work at the intersection of technology, data, and customer experience, helping JYSK take the next step in optimisation, personalisation, and marketing automation across digital channels.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

This is an opportunity to join a large international retailer where your work will have a visible impact across multiple markets. You will play a key role in strengthening JYSK's capabilities within conversion rate optimisation, email marketing automation, customer journey optimisation, and email deliverability.

You will become part of a team that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We believe in giving our employees responsibility and freedom with accountability, allowing you to influence both your own development and how we work. At JYSK, your dedication creates opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to business results across our international organisation.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in shaping and improving customer journeys across multiple international markets

• The opportunity to establish new ways of working within landing page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation

• Responsibility and freedom to drive projects and improvements within your area of expertise

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues across Marketing, Ecommerce, Customer Data and IT

• Professional development opportunities within CRO, marketing automation, customer journey optimisation and email deliverability

• Access to modern MarTech platforms and technologies used by a leading international retailer

• An informal and supportive working environment characterised by trust, teamwork and straightforward communication

As Email Marketing Automation & Conversion Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, testing, implementing, and scaling optimisation initiatives that improve customer experiences and business performance. Combining analytical insight, technical understanding, and stakeholder management, you will transform data into tangible results.

One of your first achievements in the role will be helping establish stronger ways of working around landing pages and conversion optimisation while driving initiatives that strengthen inbox presence, sender reputation, and email performance across JYSK markets.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

While you are self-driven and capable of working independently, you also value collaboration and actively share knowledge and best practices with colleagues. Based on the preferred behavioural profile, you are likely to balance independence with collaboration, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and take a methodical approach to problem-solving.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 14th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.
